editorial: Today, tools focusing on codebase memory and autonomous agent architectures stand out in the developer ecosystem. Time series forecasting models shared by Google Research offer an important resource that expands data-based forecasting capabilities.

items.title: DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp
items.summary: Developed by DeusData, codebase-memory-mcp offers high-performance code analysis by converting code bases into a permanent knowledge graph. This server, written in C language, supports 158 programming languages, reducing query times to below milliseconds and greatly reducing token usage.

items.title: google-research/timesfm
items.summary: The Time Series Foundation Model, developed by Google Research, offers a pre-trained structure for forecasting processes. The model aims to standardize predictive capabilities across different domains by analyzing complex time series data.

items.title: palmier-io/palmier-pro
items.summary: Palmier Pro was developed as a video editor that runs on the macOS operating system and offers artificial intelligence-supported editing tools. This application, written in Swift language, aims to combine artificial intelligence-based workflows with local system performance.

items.title: koala73/worldmonitor
items.summary: Worldmonitor offers a real-time global intelligence dashboard that combines AI-powered news compilation and geopolitical monitoring features in a single interface. This tool, which provides infrastructure monitoring and situational awareness, facilitates analysis processes by visualizing complex data flows.

items.title: aishwaryanr/awesome-generative-ai-guide
items.summary: The awesome-generative-ai-guide repository collects current research, interview resources and notebooks in the field of generative artificial intelligence (generative AI) in one place. This resource serves as a comprehensive learning and reference center for developers and researchers.

items.title: BuilderIO/agent-native
items.summary: Developed by BuilderIO, agent-native is a TypeScript framework focused on creating agent-native applications for artificial intelligence agents. It allows developers to integrate agent-based workflows directly into the application architecture.

items.title: chopratejas/headroom
items.summary: Headroom reduces token usage by up to 95 percent by compressing log files, tool outputs, and contextual data chunks (RAG chunks) sent to large language models (LLM). This tool, which can be used as a library, proxy and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, aims to reduce costs while maintaining model performance.

items.title: calesthio/OpenMontage
items.summary: OpenMontage offers an open source agent-based video production system that turns AI-powered coding assistants into a comprehensive video production studio. The platform automates video creation processes with 12 different workflows, 52 tools and more than 500 agent skills.

items.title: zai-org/GLM-5
items.summary: GLM-5 offers a framework that aims to transition from coding-oriented development processes to agent-based engineering capable of autonomous task execution. This project aims to standardize artificial intelligence-supported workflows in software development processes.

items.title: withastro/flue
items.summary: Based on TypeScript, Flue offers a sandbox framework that allows developers to create AI agents in secure and isolated environments. This tool increases control during the development phase by standardizing the runtime processes of agents.

items.title: n0-computer/iroh
items.summary: Iroh offers a modular networking stack that communicates via cryptographic keys instead of IP addresses. This tool, developed with the Rust language, aims to overcome the restrictions of address-based systems to ensure the continuity of network connections.

items.title: obra/superpowers
items.summary: Superpowers offers a framework and methodology that combines software development processes with agent-based skills. This structure, written in Shell language, aims to standardize the workflows of autonomous systems.

items.title: penpot/penpot
items.summary: Penpot is an open source design tool that strengthens collaboration between designers and developers. Its vector-based interface supports working via standard file formats by combining design and code processes on a common platform.

items.title: Kong/insomnia
items.summary: Insomnia is an open source application programming interface (API) client that supports GraphQL, REST, WebSockets, SSE and gRPC protocols. The software offers developers a multiplatform testing environment with cloud, local and Git-based storage options.

items.title: Lightricks/LTX-2
items.summary: Developed by Lightricks, LTX-2 offers a Python-based inference and low-order adaptation (LoRA) training suite for artificial intelligence models that generate audio and video. This tool allows users to fine-tune video production models with custom data sets.

items.title: Hyundai buys Boston Dynamics
items.summary: Hyundai increased its control in the field of robotics by purchasing all of its shares in Boston Dynamics from SoftBank for $ 325 million. This move strengthens the automotive manufacturer's strategic investments in autonomous mobility and humanoid robot technologies.

items.title: Norway imposes near ban on AI in elementary school
items.summary: Norway has enacted a new regulation that includes restrictions on the use of artificial intelligence in primary schools. This decision aims to protect data privacy in the educational environment and control students' interaction with digital tools.

items.title: Project Valhalla, Explained: How a Decade of Work Arrives in JDK 28
items.summary: Project Valhalla aims to increase performance by providing value types and improved memory layout support on the Java Virtual Machine (JVM). This work makes memory usage more efficient by optimizing data locality in object-oriented programming.

items.title: There are no instances in ATProto
items.summary: Unlike traditional social networks, the ATProto protocol uses a user-oriented data structure instead of central servers. This architecture offers a portability feature that allows users to move their accounts between different platforms.

items.title: Court Records Should Be Free
items.summary: The Electronic Frontier Foundation argues that fees charged for access to court records hinder transparency. This approach emphasizes that public legal documents should be freely and unrestrictedly accessible digitally.

items.title: yuxinlu1/gemma-4-12B-coder-fable5-composer2.5-v1-GGUF
items.summary: Gemma-4-12B-coder model is a text generation model that focuses on code writing and development processes. This structure, presented in GGUF format, uses a quantization method that enables the model to run more efficiently on different hardware resources.

items.title: zai-org/GLM-5.2
items.summary: GLM-5.2, developed by Zai-org, is a language model optimized for text generation tasks. The model is used in various content creation processes with its extensive language processing capabilities.

items.title: MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3
items.summary: MiniMax-M3, developed by MiniMaxAI, is a multimodal model that can process visual and text data simultaneously. The system offers a structure that produces text-based outputs by combining image and text inputs.

items.title: moonshotai/Kimi-K2.7-Code
items.summary: Developed by Moonshot AI, Kimi-K2.7-Code is a multimodal model that produces text output by processing visual and text-based inputs. Focusing on software development processes, this model offers solutions by combining visual and textual data in coding tasks.

items.title: WeiboAI/VibeThinker-3B
items.summary: VibeThinker-3B, developed by WeiboAI, is a compact language model focused on text generation. This structure, which has 3 billion parameters, aims to provide performance in text creation tasks with resource efficiency.
